question: The cost of painting the surface of a large spherical ball at the rate of ₹2.40 per cm² is ₹9,240. What is the radius (in cm) of the ball? (Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of painting the surface of a spherical ball = ₹9,240

Rate of painting per cm² = ₹2.40

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of Sphere = 4 × π × r²

Total Cost = Surface Area × Rate per cm²

**Calculation:**

Total Cost = ₹9,240

Rate per cm² = ₹2.40

Surface Area = Total Cost / Rate per cm²

Surface Area = 9240 / 2.40

Surface Area = 3850 cm²

Surface Area = 4 × π × r²

⇒ 3850 = 4 × 22/7 × r²

⇒ r² = 3850 × 7 / (4 × 22)

⇒ r² = 3850 × 7 / 88

⇒ r² = 306.25

⇒ r = √306.25

⇒ r = 17.5 cm

**The radius of the spherical ball is 17.5 cm.**
